title: international-touch-imu: analysis code for international touch match demands and stride mechanics measured with foot-mounted inertial sensors
description: Analysis code accompanying a programme of papers on the 2025 Trans-Tasman Test Series in international touch, measured with foot-mounted inertial measurement units. Release v1.0-P2 adds the script that reproduces every value reported in 'Same series, different formats: women's versus mixed-sex international touch match demands' (Science and Medicine in Football, submitted 2026): three families of linear mixed models (format contrast, women by format, sex within the mixed format), Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment, intraclass correlations, the load-share metrics within the mixed squad and the within-player November-to-April crossover values. The P1 script (release v1.0-P1) remains in the repository. No data are included; the de-identified datasets are available from the author on reasonable request under the governing data-sharing agreement.
